observations: Photo 0 shows a tall, black, two-door wardrobe or cabinet in a dimly lit, unfinished room with exposed brick walls.
The cabinet has a vertical seam down the middle, suggesting two doors.
There are visible scratches and scuffs on the surface, especially on the right door.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same cabinet, with two vertical metal handles or pull strips, one on each door.
A bundle of red and white wires hangs from the center, possibly from a broken lock or handle mechanism.
The cabinet appears to be made of metal or MDF with a black laminate finish.
No brand or model is visible on the cabinet in either photo.
The seller's text mentions 'Fairy', which may refer to a brand, but no such label is visible in the photos.
